topic: Professional Summary
text:
Atharva Hudlikar is an AI researcher and engineer specializing in large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multimodal AI, computer vision, and production machine learning systems.

His experience spans clinical AI research, enterprise AI products, AI infrastructure, information retrieval, generative models, and production ML deployment. He has worked on systems involving LLMs, vision models, structured data, agentic AI, and multimodal pipelines.
